# Ashutosh Jha — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Ashutosh Jha, a Political Science graduate interested in technology, data analytics, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, international relations, public policy, and geopolitics.

## About

Ashutosh Jha is a Political Science graduate from Galgotias University with a BA (Hons) in Political Science. He is currently pursuing an MA in Political Science through IGNOU.

His interests combine political science and technology, with a growing focus on data analytics, cybersecurity, Python, SQL, Power BI, and AI.

## Education

Data analytics project using SQL and Power BI to analyze sales performance, revenue, products, and business trends.

Data analysis project focused on employee attrition, workforce patterns, and HR insights.

Exploratory data analysis project examining Netflix content, genres, release patterns, and other dataset trends.

Personal AI assistant project integrating AI, voice interaction, memory, automation, computer context, and system-control capabilities.
